issues.description: Visibility mismatch for the Farm.animals attribute: the UML in the problem statement declares animals as a private attribute (aggregation - animals: List<Animal>) and the exercise text asks for getter and setter, but the solution implementation declares the field as public (public List<Animal> animals;). This deviates from the intended encapsulation and may confuse students about whether the field should be directly accessible or private with accessors.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the animals field private to match the UML and the exercise instructions (e.g., private List<Animal> animals;) and keep the public getter and setter. Update any direct usages of the public field in the solution to use the getter/setter or internal methods (addAnimal, feedAllAnimals) so the field remains encapsulated.
